symbols.name: input bit
symbols.meaning: The first of the two bits that an XOR combines.
symbols.quote: The bitwise sum modulo 2 of two bits $a$ and $b$, written $a \oplus b$, is 1 exactly when the bits differ.

symbols.name: input bit
symbols.meaning: The second of the two bits that an XOR combines.
symbols.quote: The bitwise sum modulo 2 of two bits $a$ and $b$, written $a \oplus b$, is 1 exactly when the bits differ.

symbols.name: exclusive or
symbols.meaning: The XOR operation: $a \oplus b$ is the bitwise sum modulo 2 of the bits $a$ and $b$, which is 1 exactly when they differ.
symbols.quote: The bitwise sum modulo 2 of two bits $a$ and $b$, written $a \oplus b$, is 1 exactly when the bits differ.
